title: Tunisian Lamb Kebabs
description: Tender lamb skewers marinated in a blend of Tunisian spices, grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of couscous or pita bread.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together the Tunisian spice blend, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
3. Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and toss to coat.
4. Thread the lamb, red onion, bell pepper, zucchini, and rosemary (if using) onto skewers.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
6. Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
